data.name: Space Memory TDG
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Classic memory gameplay meets galactic trials, ancient power structures, and humanity’s fight for survival.

In Space Memory TDG, your memory is not just a game mechanic — it is Earth’s last line of defense. Humanity has been declared the Fourth Trial World by the powerful Qhyr’Vuun Empire. Eight influential Houses are watching every decision, every mistake, and every perfect match.

Your goal is clear: survive the cosmic trials, master the sectors of space, and prove that humanity deserves its place in a much larger universe.

The Eight Houses of the Qhyr’Vuun Empire

The universe of Space Memory TDG is expanding, and the powers behind the trials are finally stepping into the light.

The Eight Houses are more than distant observers. They are powerful factions with their own ideals, strategies, rivalries, and visions for the future. Some see humanity as potential. Others see Earth as a risk. Some are waiting to discover whether this Trial World can become something greater.

Each House represents a different form of power, discipline, control, and cosmic ambition. The trials are not random challenges — they are part of a larger selection process where focus, precision, and mental strength may decide the future of Earth.

The Challenge

Forget relaxed card matching. In Space Memory TDG, every second matters.

Travel through different sectors and face memory trials that demand fast pattern recognition, clean decision-making, and absolute concentration. Every mistake costs time. Every perfect run brings you closer to a higher score.

Only those who stay calm under the pressure of alien observers can break the records and prove that humanity should not be underestimated.

Two Paths to Victory

Sequential Mode

A structured journey through the stars. Complete one stage after another, overcome challenges, and progress through the trials of the Fourth Trial World.

This mode is ideal for experiencing the progression of the saga and fighting your way through the cosmic sectors step by step.

Free Play Mode

A training ground for perfectionists. Choose specific stages, practice patterns, improve reaction time, and optimize your runs.

This mode is all about control, repetition, and chasing the perfect high score.

Strategy & Efficiency

Time is the most valuable resource in this universe. Your performance is based on several factors:

Memory Skill: How fast can you find the correct pairs?

Precision: How many mistakes can you avoid?

Speed: How efficiently can you make decisions?

Multiplier Control: How long can you keep your streak alive?

Playing fast is not enough. Reckless choices can destroy your score. Calm focus, sharp pattern recognition, and clean execution are the keys to cosmic-level results.

A Growing Universe

Space Memory TDG is the beginning of a larger sci-fi saga.

The First Episode lays the foundation for Earth’s story as the Fourth Trial World. With new updates, the universe continues to grow: the Eight Houses are being introduced more deeply, the background of the Qhyr’Vuun Empire is expanding, and new threats are being prepared.

Upcoming Elite UFOs will push the system even further and increase the pressure on humanity. What begins here is only the first step into a much larger universe.

Features

🧠 Classic Memory, Modernized
Fast and focused gameplay built around concentration, pattern recognition, and efficient decisions.

🌌 Sci-Fi Lore Around the Eight Houses
Discover the background of the Qhyr’Vuun Empire and the eight powerful Houses overseeing Earth’s trials.

⏱ Highscore-Focused Gameplay
Time, precision, and mistake control determine your final score.

🃏 Thematic Card Sets
Visual designs that support the space setting and the atmosphere of the Trial World.

🚀 Sequential Mode
Progress through the sectors and complete one challenge after another.

🎯 Free Play Mode
Train specific stages, refine your technique, and improve your personal bests.

🏆 Competitive Run Optimization
Perfect your runs, maintain your multiplier, and prove that humanity is ready for the stars.

👽 Preparing for New Threats
The universe continues to expand with new systems, stronger enemies, and upcoming Elite UFOs.

Become Part of the Universe

Space Memory TDG is growing step by step. Use this early phase to join the journey, support the game with feedback and reviews, and become part of a new sci-fi universe as it takes shape.

Earth is under observation.

The Eight Houses are waiting.

Your memory will decide.

If you want to dive deeper into the lore, you can find more information about the Eight Houses and the Everest Alliance on the official website:

Eight Houses:

Everest Alliance:

data.short_description: Dive into 'Space Memory TDG,' an action-packed memory game set in space. Match pairs, master turret mode, disrupt UFO activities, and collect points through speed and strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 oder AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 oder besser
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard-Soundkarte
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 oder AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 oder besser
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard-Soundkarte
